changes: Truncate disposable workload tables before each scenario to remove DELETE purge backlog
Count only complete cycles within measurement window
Sample waiting lock tables every second and host load every five seconds
acceptance: All 12 variant/scenario groups must have two samples and CV <= 0.15. Zero application errors, zero active orders, atomic outbox. No automatic enablement.
scope: Controller and actual MySQL transactions; local independent storage comparison, not a production HTTP capacity claim
storage: Dedicated persistent MySQL datadir on separate physical NVMe SSD E:, same immutable image, 1 GiB limit, flush-at-commit=1 and sync-binlog=1
hostSampling: Every 5 seconds: per-physical-disk queues and byte rates, CPU, available memory
supersedes: 20261103-134337 stopped after one complete baseline run due to observed throughput collapse and shared disk queue spikes. Its full results retained.
